headline: 克萊恩新書談末日
context: 作家娜歐蜜·克萊恩（Naomi Klein）長期批判新自由主義，如今把矛頭轉向科技巨富。她與作家阿斯特拉·泰勒（Astra Taylor）合著新書指出，有一股她們稱為「末日法西斯」的勢力，其實根本不介意地球走向毀滅。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: She’s tackled neoliberalism and the digital world, now the writer and activist is taking on tech billionaires. She explains how the super-rich are capitalising on climate and financial chaos in pursuit of power Naomi Klein’s new book starts on a mountaintop with two “faithful men gathering an audience to share their vision”. It’s a vision of a paradise city, gated at every entrance, no need for weapons there, everyone in it rich. One of the men has tears in his eyes as he describes its beauty. The opening scene of End Times Fascism, co-written with Astra Taylor, is not a metaphor, however. The men are Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff. The year is 2026, the mountain is Davos. The paradise city will be called New Gaza . The World Economic Forum get-together in Davos , Switzerland, has always had a twin purpose – to provide a platform for the super-rich to describe all the good they are doing on poverty and climate, and to give us a glimpse into their enviable lives. This year what we witnessed was, quite brazenly, the world’s richest men gathering to discuss the real estate possibilities of a mass grave. Continue reading...
sources.title: Naomi Klein: ‘Extreme wealth has a deranging effect. It turns you into a supremacist’

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: In a new book, the writers argue that a powerful coalition of “end times fascists” is just fine with the earth’s demise.
sources.title: Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor Say the End of the World Is Now on the Table

thread_text:
克萊恩新書談末日

作家娜歐蜜·克萊恩（Naomi Klein）長期批判新自由主義，如今把矛頭轉向科技巨富，談的是超級富豪如何利用氣候與金融動盪牟利。

她與作家阿斯特拉·泰勒（Astra Taylor）合著新書指出，有一股她們稱為「末日法西斯」的勢力，其實根本不介意地球走向毀滅。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times，2026 年 9 月 12 日至 13 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
克萊恩新書談末日

作家娜歐蜜·克萊恩（Naomi Klein）長期批判新自由主義，如今把矛頭轉向科技巨富，談的是超級富豪如何利用氣候與金融動盪牟利。

她與作家阿斯特拉·泰勒（Astra Taylor）合著新書指出，有一股她們稱為「末日法西斯」的勢力，其實根本不介意地球走向毀滅。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 12 日至 13 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 作家娜歐蜜·克萊恩（Naomi Klein），這次把矛頭轉向科技巨富。她長期批判新自由主義，現在談的是超級富豪如何利用氣候與金融動盪牟利。她跟作家阿斯特拉·泰勒（Astra Taylor）合寫了一本新書，主張有一股她們稱為「末日法西斯」的勢力，其實根本不介意地球走向毀滅。
